newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares initial gains on dlr short-cover.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares initial gains on dlr short-cover.

text.p: The Mexican peso shed some of its opening gains in late morning trade on Thursday due to some brokers covering short dollar positions ahead of this weekend's mid-term elections, traders said.
"The market is very calm and is just squaring positions ahead of the (July 6) mid-term elections elections," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 1.0 and 0.3 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.9525/7.9550 and 7.9490/7.9520 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 0.8 of a centavo firmer at 7.9300/7.9330 per dollar.
